app.name: gitlab-upgrade
check.current: Already on the latest available version: {version}
plan.title: Upgrade plan
plan.nothing: Nothing to upgrade - already on the latest available version.
plan.limitedBy.os-ceiling: stopping here: ceiling of the current OS
plan.limitedBy.latest-available: this is the newest version in the repository
plan.reason.latest-patch-of-current-mino: latest patch of the current minor
plan.noRollback: There is no rollback: a downgrade cannot undo the database migrations.
plan.noRollbackHint: The only way back is a backup or a VM snapshot taken before you start.
policy.backup.first-full: first backup full, the rest fast
error.notRoot: Root privileges are required: run this with sudo.
error.noOs: Could not read /etc/os-release - Ubuntu and Debian are supported.
error.unsupportedOs: OS {os} is not supported: Ubuntu or Debian is required.
error.noGitlab: No GitLab Omnibus found: neither a gitlab-ee/gitlab-ce package nor a VERSION file.
error.noPackages: The package repository is unreachable: apt-cache madison returned nothing.
error.noPackagesHint: Check access with: gitlab-upgrade proxy test
finding.missing-stop-package: No package in the repository for required stop {stop} - the path is broken.
help.tagline: gitlab-upgrade — safe upgrades for self-managed GitLab Omnibus
help.exits: Exit codes for check and plan: 0 current · 10 patch · 20 minor · 30 major · 1 error
help.agents: Machine-readable command catalog for agents: gitlab-upgrade api  (same as --help --json)
cmd.check.summary: is there anything to upgrade; answers with an exit code, changes nothing
cmd.plan.summary: the full upgrade plan with checks; changes nothing
cmd.api.summary: machine-readable catalog of commands, flags and exit codes as JSON
cmd.help.summary: full help, or help for one command
flag.safe-for-os.desc: do not go above the current OS ceiling
flag.patch-only.desc: only a patch within the current minor
flag.proxy.desc: proxy for packages.gitlab.com: http://… or socks5://…
flag.proxy-ca.desc: corporate proxy CA for TLS interception
flag.proxy-all-apt.desc: proxy every repository, not just gitlab
flag.json.desc: a single JSON result document on stdout
flag.explain-config.desc: show where each setting came from
exit.current: already on the latest available version
exit.patch: a patch is available in the current minor
exit.error: error: repository unreachable or version undetectable
api.note.exitCodes: The exit code is the primary answer: 0 current, 10 patch, 20 minor, 30 major, 1 error.
api.note.envelope: With --json, stdout carries exactly one JSON document of the shape described here.
api.note.events: With --events, the JSONL event stream goes to stderr and never mixes with the result.
api.note.ids: Key off the stable id and code fields, not message text: message is translated.
result.plan.limitedBy: what bound the top of the path
error.code.os-unsupported: unsupported OS: Ubuntu or Debian is required
error.code.gitlab-not-found: no GitLab Omnibus found on this server
error.code.repository-unreachable: package repository unreachable - check the proxy
plan.reason.conditional-stop: conditional stop - taken to be safe
plan.stale: The upgrade path data was verified on {date} and may be out of date. Refresh it: gitlab-upgrade refresh-path
refresh.same: Data is current: {n} stops, no differences from the official file.
refresh.dryRun: Nothing written. To apply: gitlab-upgrade refresh-path --yes
refresh.failed: Could not fetch the official file: {reason}
cmd.refresh-path.summary: compare the required stops with the official upgrade_path.yml
result.refresh-path.stops: how many stops the official file has
result.refresh-path.removed: stops no longer in the official file
result.refresh-path.applied: whether the changes were written to the data file
cmd.next.summary: the next version to install and why, per the official documentation
next.none: Nothing to upgrade: {version} is the latest available.
result.next.version: package version to install right now
result.next.remaining: how many steps remain after this one
result.next.final: whether this is the final step
result.next.stop: the minor version of the stop per the official file
result.next.docs: official notes for the major series
result.next.source: where the required stops came from
result.next.verifiedAt: when the data was checked against the source
exit.step-current: nothing to upgrade, no steps left
exit.step-patch: the next step is a patch within the current minor
exit.step-minor: the next step moves to a new minor
exit.step-major: the next step moves to a new major
check.root.title: root privileges
check.omnibus.title: GitLab Omnibus
check.services.title: GitLab services
check.migrations.title: background migrations
check.secrets.title: gitlab-secrets.json
check.disk.title: disk space
check.apt-busy.title: apt is free
check.session.title: session
check.os-ceiling.title: OS compatibility
check.postgres.title: PostgreSQL
check.root.critical: root privileges are required: run this with sudo
check.omnibus-container.critical: this is a container, not Omnibus - Docker and Helm are out of scope
check.migrations-pending.warn: {n} outstanding - wait for them before starting
check.migrations-failed.critical: {n} failed: cannot continue, the next step would migrate over unfinished data
check.secrets.critical: missing - a backup cannot be restored without it
check.disk.critical: {path} has {free} GB free, at least {need} GB is required
check.disk-cache.warn: / has {free} GB free, the package cache needs about {need} GB
check.apt-busy.critical: busy with another process: wait for it to finish
check.apt-timer.warn: apt-daily.timer is active - it will grab the dpkg lock mid-install
check.session.warn: SSH without tmux: a dropped connection ends the watch, see --detach
check.os-ceiling.warn: {os} supports up to {max}, but the target is {target} - add --safe-for-os
doctor.blocked: There are critical problems - the upgrade will not start until they are resolved.
doctor.warned: There are warnings. To continue anyway: --force
cmd.doctor.summary: readiness checks only, no plan and no changes
flag.force.desc: ignore warnings (does not clear critical ones)
check.postgres-above.warn: version {have} is above the tested maximum {max} for {target}
